subject: packages/ink probe.test.ts 'does not count work that waits between a callback and its microtasks' is load-sensitive
body: It fails under 'pnpm -r test' with parallel workspaces on a loaded 4-core sandbox (measured 12.8 ms vs the < 10 ms bound, twice in my integrate gate) and passes 3/3 alone. Could the bound be relative to a measured baseline (like your fps test) rather than an absolute 10 ms? Not touching it.
